blinding_and_label_swap_protocol.anonymization: Both Condition A and Condition B outputs are stripped of pipeline metadata, model names, internal task tokens, and presented neutrally as REPORT X and REPORT Y.

mirrored_evaluations.adjudication_rule: If Eval 1 and Eval 2 disagree on a RELEASE-GATE core dimension (Win vs Loss), a 3rd independent adjudication session is triggered.
mirrored_evaluations.eval_1: REPORT X = Condition A (or B according to deterministic hash assignment), REPORT Y = opposite.
mirrored_evaluations.eval_2: REPORT X = opposite of eval_1, REPORT Y = opposite of eval_1 (Full Label & Position Swap).

condition_a.description: Strong standalone direct-AI reading without intermediate Evidentia scaffolding or guidance.
condition_a.direct_reading_prompt:
你是一位顶尖的资深跨学科科学家与同行评审专家。请直接阅读附带的原始研究论文完整 PDF，针对学术研究同行撰写一份达到发表级标准的深度精读报告（以流畅、严谨、深度的中文阐述）。

【核心阅读要求】
1. 遵循论文原生论证结构：首先准确判断并刻画本篇论文独特的论证结构与推进逻辑（例如：是理论推导与经验证伪、系统构建与工程实证、测量协议与外推边界、还是观测建模与不确定性反演？）。切忌套用千篇一律的模板。
2. 核心主张与问题重构：明确论文试图确立的核心命题（Thesis），作者针对的核心科学/技术问题是什么，该问题在领域内的实质痛点何在。
3. 理论框架、研究设计与方法机制：详细阐释其方法构造、数学理论基础或实验设计逻辑。对关键数学定义、核心方程、算法机制或物理测量流程进行严密剖析。
4. 决定性实证或证明链条：剖析论文中支撑核心主张的最关键证据链（实验基准、对照实验、消融分析、反事实扰动或定理证明构造）。必须明确指涉并准确解读论文中的关键图表（Figures）、表格（Tables）和公式（Equations），指出其在论证链条中所承担的具体证明作用。
5. 结论校准与事实边界：区分作者的主观声称（Author claims）与受证据真正支持的客观边界（Justified assessment）。明确指出方法的先决假设、脆弱性、未完全解决的张力（Unresolved tensions）与适用边界。

【格式与风格要求】
- 请勿使用生硬的机械八股格式，按本论文内在的逻辑自然展开各章节。
- 在涉及数据、实验结果、图表与定理处，务必尽量标注具体出处（例如引用 Fig. 2、Table 1、Eq. 3、Section 4 或对应页码）。
- 保持批判性视角与极高的科学诚实度。

evaluation_dimensions.description: 叙述的连贯性、逻辑推进的自然度、宏观论证与微观机制的融合深度。
evaluation_dimensions.label: Narrative clarity
evaluation_dimensions.name: narrative_clarity

evaluation_dimensions.description: 科学内容的完备性，是否涵盖论文的所有核心命题、机制分支与关键实证环节。
evaluation_dimensions.label: Scientific completeness
evaluation_dimensions.name: scientific_completeness

evaluation_dimensions.description: 对算法、数学推导、测量方案或实验设计的剖析深度与准确度。
evaluation_dimensions.label: Method / study-design / proof explanation
evaluation_dimensions.name: method_explanation

evaluation_dimensions.description: 对实验数据、关键指标、比较基线及消融结果的理解精确性与细致度。
evaluation_dimensions.label: Experiment / result understanding
evaluation_dimensions.name: experiment_result_understanding

evaluation_dimensions.description: 对论文具体图、表、公式的指引、解读与引用准确性，图文绑定的精确度。
evaluation_dimensions.label: Figure / table / equation correctness
evaluation_dimensions.name: figure_table_correctness

evaluation_dimensions.description: 结论的审慎度与校准程度，是否严格区分证据支持的事实与作者过度声称。
evaluation_dimensions.label: Conclusion calibration
evaluation_dimensions.name: conclusion_calibration

evaluation_dimensions.description: 对方法适用范围、理论假设、计算瓶颈或数据局限性的挖掘深度。
evaluation_dimensions.label: Limitations / boundary coverage
evaluation_dimensions.name: boundary_coverage

evaluation_dimensions.description: 展现出的学术批判眼光，能否指出论文潜在的张力、未解之谜与深层涵义。
evaluation_dimensions.label: Critical insight
evaluation_dimensions.name: critical_insight

evaluation_dimensions.description: 是否存在脱离原文事实的虚构、无根据脑补或歪曲（得分越低代表幻觉越多，5分代表完全无幻觉）。
evaluation_dimensions.label: Unsupported / hallucinated prose (Safety)
evaluation_dimensions.name: unsupported_prose

evaluation_dimensions.description: 对论文推断不确定性、置信区间、测量噪声或未覆盖变量的处理明确程度。
evaluation_dimensions.label: Explicit uncertainty handling
evaluation_dimensions.name: explicit_uncertainty_handling

evaluation_dimensions.description: 证据追溯性与可审计性：读者能否轻松将正文论述核验回原始页码、图表与引文。
evaluation_dimensions.label: Provenance / auditability usefulness
evaluation_dimensions.name: provenance_usefulness

evaluation_dimensions.description: 整体精读综合体验：读者读完后能否透彻、系统、全面地掌握该篇研究。
evaluation_dimensions.label: Overall paper comprehension
evaluation_dimensions.name: overall_understandability

evaluation_dimensions.description: 是否贴合该论文独有的学术叙事形态，而非粗暴套用通用的研究套路。
evaluation_dimensions.label: Paper-specific narrative completeness (Anti-template)
evaluation_dimensions.name: paper_specific_narrative_completeness

evaluation_dimensions.description: 是否存在预置模板或机械架构痕迹（5分代表完全无模板偏见泄露，1分代表严重模板套用）。
evaluation_dimensions.label: Template-bias leakage (Anti-template Safety)
evaluation_dimensions.name: template_bias_leakage

operational_policies.missing_run_policy: No paper may be declared complete until both Condition A and Condition B outputs are fully produced and validated.
operational_policies.quota_interruption_policy: If quota is reached, checkpoint completed artifacts and durable receipts cleanly, pause, and resume later using the identical canonical Gemini model. Never substitute alternative models.

rules.description: Condition B must not materially regress versus Condition A on Narrative Clarity, Scientific Completeness, and Method/Proof Explanation across the corpus. No final adjudicated LOSS on these 3 dimensions for UNSEEN-01.
Condition B must demonstrate clear corpus-level added value in Figure/Table/Equation Correctness, Limitations/Boundary Coverage, Explicit Uncertainty, and Provenance/Auditability.
Condition B must not increase unsupported scientific claims relative to Condition A. Any severe source-inconsistent hallucination in Condition B is release-blocking.
Condition B must retain paper-specific narrative diversity validated in Issue #22. UNSEEN-01 must not be forced into an engineering-paper pipeline template.
UNSEEN-01 must be evaluated and reported in the primary release gate unconditionally.
